name: Abandoned Subway
voice: Drow: Oh... hello. I made a party tape for the vampire. Could you take it? Only if you are going that way...

name: Forest Campsite
voice: Wolfwoman: There you are, little courier! Honey for the bear, rosin for the drow, flowers for granny. Leave the forest to your big sister!

name: Mead Cellar
voice: Bear: The honey is late, the labels are damp... Oh dear, I am rambling again. Will my mead be ready for the party?

name: Abandoned Radio Tower
voice: Vampire: Hail, brave courier! By my honor, the feast shall have music. First, I must rescue this most unchivalrous radio.

name: Museum Ruins
voice: Zombie: Oh, a visitor! Did I order flowers? Yes, for the cakes. Come in, dear... which century is it again?

name: Settlement Bar
voice: Witch: Right, darling, one thing at a time. Blood and repairs for our knight, supplies for the bear, then supper. I have the list.
